entries.title: Ask HN: Does anyone else find the AWS Lambda developer experience frustrating?
entries.author: tdfirth
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Does anyone else find the AWS Lambda developer experience frustrating?
entries.excerpt: Hey HN, I've been using AWS lambda a bit recently, mostly as a way to glue together various bits and pieces. Maybe I'm doing this wrong but does anyone else find the experience to be really frustrating? I can unit test bits of the code just fine, but at some point I always end up stuck in a slow feedback loop where I deploy the code, do some manual invoking, go and dig through the logs in CloudWatch, add another print statement in my lambda... and so on. entries.guide_zh: 用 AWS Lambda 串联服务时频遇不便，其他开发者是否也觉得体验挫败？

entries.title: Ask HN: Why is the Linux community struggling to implement hibernation?
entries.author: cyka178
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Why is the Linux community struggling to implement hibernation?
entries.excerpt: Today I have found out that hibernation is by default disabled in my Ubuntu 18.04 distribution. After this, I found this 11 month old post https://discourse.ubuntu.com/t/re-visiting-hibernate-on-ubun... where I realized that the Linux community does not seem to be able to implement a working implementation of hibernate. Is there any reason why this is a difficult problem? I would like to have an option in my OS like VM's have where everything that is currently running is save
entries.guide_zh: 发现 Ubuntu 默认禁用休眠后，发帖者询问 Linux 休眠支持为何如此困难。
